senses.gloss: m. (τήγανον, τάγηνον, also ἥγανον, v. Lydd.-Scott Gr. Dict. s. v.; prob. of Semitic origin = <he>תגן</he>, denom. of <he>אגן</he>; as for <cite ref="I00000"><he>ט</he></cite> = <cite ref="V00000"><he>ת</he></cite> cmp. Syr. <he>טגר</he> P. Sm. 1432 with Chald. <he>תגרא</he>)
frying pan; also (interch. with טִיגּוּן) a flour-dish prepared with oil.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 21a:21">Snh. 21ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>ותצק</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 13:9">II Sam. XIII, 9</cite>) <he>עשתה לו מיני ט׳</he> she made for him oil-dishes.

<cite ref="Menachot 104b:11">Men. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ מיני טיגון</he> (most eds.) five sorts of oil-dishes (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 2:1">Lev. II, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Leviticus 2:4">4</cite>; <cite ref="Leviticus 2:5">5</cite>; <cite ref="Leviticus 2:7">7</cite>; <cite ref="Leviticus 2:14-15">14—15</cite>).—Pl. <he>טִיגָּנִין</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:1">Tosef. Ab. Zar. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:1">VI</cite>), 1; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:2">VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 9:2">IX</cite>), 2 <he>הט׳</he> the frying pans.

senses.gloss: (cmp. Syr. טוגנא, P. Sm. 1431) an engine of torture and execution.
units: Pesik. R. s. 43 נתנוהו בתיך הטיגנו (read: הטיגנן or הטיגנון) they put him into the teganon.

Men. 50ᵇ (expl. תפיני, Lev. VI, 14; 21) אופה ואח״כ מְטַגְּנָהּ one baked it and then fried it with oil; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְטוּגָּן. Y. Ned. VI, beg. 39ᶜ. [Ib. VI, end, 40ᵃ, v. next w.]—2) to torture, put to death. Pesik. R. l. c. וטיגס אותו (Var. וטגים), read: אותו וטִיגְּנוּ or וטִיגְּנוּהוּ.—Trnsf. to torture, agonize. Tanḥ. Vayiggash 9 אתה טִגַּנְתָּה וכ׳ thou causedst agony to thy father &c.
